title: Chalium - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Chalium in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Chalium is a light-element weapon used by Maelle. It scales with Agility (D), Vitality (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Chalium
sections.content:
Location: Sinister Cave - Chromatic Challier drop.

Obtained from Sinister Cave - Chromatic Challier drop.

sections.title: Is the Chalium Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (D), Vitality (C). A dedicated light pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
